notes.title: Make Prehistoric Worlds with Caveman!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26305641/6b01a33e6d805bc31aaac5b62bc9dfa722f8847b.png[/img]

Hey everyone

Let us introduce you Caveman, one of the 6 new controllable characters present in The Sandbox Evolution, which you will be able to use to create your own games & levels!

[h1]Caveman is a prehistoric Character[/h1]
His skills are:
[list]
[*]Club Attack: attack all enemies with your club!
[*]Bounce: jump higher by boucing above animals!
[*]Endurance: a strong character with many lives!
[*]Swimming: he is smooth moving under water!
[/list]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26305641/522fa107ba3024aba3002342df7eae2915eed3d2.png[/img]


Here he is in action - how awesome !?
[img]http://www.thesandboxgame.com/gif/TSBEvolution%20PC%20-%20Caveman%20Hero.gif[/img]


We can't wait to see the levels you will craft and share to the Online Gallery with him!

Mark the Date! The game will launch on November 16th, 2016:
http://store.steampowered.com/app/466940  (you can already add it to your wishlist!)

The Sandbox Team

notes.notes:

Here comes the update 1.9.05 which should address stability issues of the game as we reduced the footprint of the game on the graphic memory.

- Reduced memory footprint


Feel free to share your feedback with us! 

Thank you for your support! 
The Sandbox Team

notes.title: Update Version 1.9.03 (September 27th, 2014)

Hello sandboxers!

notes.title: Update Version 1.7.02 (July 29th, 2014)
notes.notes:
Hello sandboxers! 

It’s been a while, let’s get down to this new 1.700 update.
We are still on our path to introduce exclusives features for the PC version, and controls are way better now!

[IMG]http://i60.tinypic.com/wuotjq.png[/IMG]

Check out below all the new stuff! 
[h1]What's New in 1.7.02?[/h1]

[u]Steam Exclusives[/u]
▪ Steam achievements!
▪ New key Mapping:

- Navigate faster on the field!
[code] P : Pause/Unpause
 A/D - LEFT/RIGHT - HORIZONTAL SCROLL : Move left/right when zoomed
 W/S - UP/DOWN - VERTICAL SCROLL : Move up/down when zoomed[/code]

- Navigate faster in menus!
[code]1,2,3,4,5,6,7 : Element tabs (1 = Humans to 7 = Basic Elements)
1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8,9 : Brush sizes[/code]

- Control tanks and ninjas!
[code]
 A/D - LEFT/RIGHT : Move left/right
 SPACEBAR : Action
[/code]

[u]New Features[/u]
▪ Play the new User-Created 2 campaign: 10 levels of content created by the community! 
▪ Improve your games and edit your levels with the 2 new Gaming elements (keyboard controllables) 
=> Ninja, Avatar
▪ Several new backgrounds! 


Feel free to share your feedback with us! 

Thank you for your support! 
The Sandbox Team

[IMG]http://i60.tinypic.com/wuotjq.png[/IMG]

Check out below all the new stuff! 
[h1]What's New in 1.7.02?[/h1]

[u]Steam Exclusives[/u]
▪ Steam achievements!
▪ New key Mapping:

- Navigate faster on the field!
[code] P : Pause/Unpause
 A/D - LEFT/RIGHT - HORIZONTAL SCROLL : Move left/right when zoomed
 W/S - UP/DOWN - VERTICAL SCROLL : Move up/down when zoomed[/code]

- Navigate faster in menus!
[code]1,2,3,4,5,6,7 : Element tabs (1 = Humans to 7 = Basic Elements)
1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8,9 : Brush sizes[/code]

- Control tanks and ninjas!
[code]
 A/D - LEFT/RIGHT : Move left/right
 SPACEBAR : Action
[/code]

[u]New Features[/u]
▪ Play the new User-Created 2 campaign: 10 levels of content created by the community! 
▪ Improve your games and edit your levels with the 2 new Gaming elements (keyboard controllables) 
=> Ninja, Avatar
▪ Several new backgrounds! 


Feel free to share your feedback with us! 

Thank you for your support! 
The Sandbox Team

notes.title: Now Available on Steam Early Access - The Sandbox
notes.notes:
The Sandbox is Now Available on Steam Early Access!

The Sandbox is a unique world building & crafting game featuring over 150+ physics elements presented in 2D pixel blocks that can interact with each others. Players can craft amazing worlds, create pixel art, chain reactions, chiptune music, advanced contraptions, electric circuits or just play with physics.

Play with basic elements ranging from simple water, stone, sand, wood, glass, lava, fire, to more complex: electricity, metal, virus, antivirus,heater, cooler, lasers, pipes, gems, sensors, leds TNT, C4, crosswire, conveyor belt, music instruments etc.
